worked_example.en: Join two equal right triangles along their longest sides. The joined side goes inside, while the four outside sides are equal and make four square corners. The new shape is a square.

worked_example_steps.en: Place the triangles so their longest sides touch. That joined side is now inside the new shape.

worked_example_answer.fil: Ang dalawang triangle ay bumubuo ng square.
